title: Specify a consistent visual character
description: Create a reusable character sheet covering silhouette, proportions, clothing, colours, props and expressions.
accomplishes: Create a reusable character sheet covering silhouette, proportions, clothing, colours, props and expressions. Separate fixed traits from scene-specific choices. Include continuity checks and avoid promising perfect identity consistency across tools or outputs.
prompt:
Act as an art director.

Task: Specify a consistent visual character.

Input context:
- CHARACTER: [CHARACTER]
- AUTHORISED REFERENCES: [AUTHORISED REFERENCES]
- SCENES: [SCENES]

Create a reusable character sheet covering silhouette, proportions, clothing, colours, props and expressions. Separate fixed traits from scene-specific choices. Include continuity checks and avoid promising perfect identity consistency across tools or outputs.

Specify composition, lighting, framing, style, desired resolution and aspect ratio. Preserve authorised references and identify details requiring human review.

Use English for explanations unless the task or user explicitly requires another language. Use clear sections and a format suited to the deliverable. If essential information is missing, ask a focused question before concluding. Label assumptions and unknowns. Do not invent facts, sources, results or completed checks. End with verification criteria and remaining limitations.
exampleResult:
## Fictional guide character
Keep a navy jacket, round notebook and recognisable silhouette consistent across front, profile and three-quarter views. Vary expression and pose without changing core proportions. Compare each later image against the approved sheet. The character is a design proposal; no real person, generated sheet or tested consistency result is claimed.
